findings.problem: The public characterization of `extToHomology` is not a rewrite rule. It takes an arbitrary cocycle `φ` and a hypothesis `hφ`, so simp cannot use it. The rewrite-friendly form `extToHomology (extClass.comp (mk₀ β)) = boundariesHom ...` exists only as the private `extToHomology_homBoundary`. That lemma is stated on `homBoundary`, which the simp lemma `homBoundary_apply` already rewrites to `extClass.comp (mk₀ f)`. So even if it were tagged `@[simp]`, its LHS would never match a simp-normal term. The result is a gap in the simp interface. Nothing in simp can evaluate `extToHomology` on a canonical `extClass.comp (mk₀ β)`, and nothing can then feed the result into the existing simp lemma `homologyπ_kronecker_homologyClassOfComp`. Downstream code works around this by hand. Naturality.lean has a private lemma `extToHomology_homBoundary_representative` that rebuilds `φ` and `hφ`. It also repeats `rw [homBoundary_apply]` and `apply extToHomology_extClass_comp_mk₀`, then discharges `hφ` manually.
findings.proposed_change: Add a public equation lemma stated on the simp-normal form. Its shape is `extToHomology k X Y i j ((kernelSequence_shortExact (X.homologyπ j)).extClass.comp (Ext.mk₀ β) (add_zero 1)) = homologyClassOfComp k Y (X.toBoundaries i j) (X.d_toBoundaries _ i j) β`. Mark it `@[simp]`. Its RHS is the canonical `homologyClassOfComp` form that the simp lemma `homologyπ_kronecker_homologyClassOfComp` already consumes, so no loop is expected. Prove it from the current proof of `extToHomology_homBoundary`, which already gives the `boundariesHom` form, and keep `extToHomology_extClass_comp_mk₀` as a corollary. Then drop the private `extToHomology_homBoundary` and the `homBoundary` form of the lemma. Naturality.lean can use the new lemma directly in its `rw` or `simp` steps.
findings.benefit: Computing `extToHomology` on a canonical Ext class becomes a single simp or rw step, with no need to supply a cocycle and its equation. It also connects with the existing `homologyClassOfComp` simp lemmas, so `kronecker (extToHomology ..)` can be simplified. Naturality.lean could drop its representative lemma and the manual `hφ` bookkeeping.
